identity.rid: nonzero monotonic uint32; never wrap; retry identical bytes only
identity.binding: B- followed by 30 lowercase hex; full SHA256 in INFO

info_snapshot.digest: SHA256 of sorted-key ASCII JSON with compact separators and no NaN; full binding_digest and B- prefix must match
info_snapshot.scope: device declarations, not independently verified hardware identity or axis calibration
info_snapshot.canonical_input: exact top-level fields, no duplicate keys, bounded ASCII JSON; byte-identical sorted-key compact serialization; all mutable declarations included in full binding digest

capture_provenance.hardware_identity_unknown: null with provenance UNKNOWN; board/driver/model/configuration/instance and MCU UID do not prove a unique sensor chip
capture_provenance.measurement_time_unknown: null measurement_uncertainty_bound_us; sample format 1 UINT32_MAX uncertainty is reserved unknown and cannot qualify; receive/decode proxies never qualify as sensor-synchronized measurements
capture_provenance.jy901b_current: 0x54 has no sensor measurement timestamp; sample/receive fields are local receive/decode proxies; sensor delay, uncertainty, epoch and native-gap qualification NOT PROVEN; remain unsupported

selection.nominal_output_millihz: explicit candidate output rate, not qualification or native IMU reconfiguration

capture_provenance.native_health: checked at every producer frame independently of selected output; missing native frames fail even when the selected sequence stride appears correct
capture_provenance.five_hz: candidate only; fixed native sequence/phase selection, never select by acceleration/magnetic values, stationarity score or transport availability; health and selected cadence have distinct deadlines
capture_provenance.static_gate: complete fixed selected windows are retained; static/quality rejection applies to the whole declared window, never selectively replaces bad values
capture_provenance.qualification_scope: host verifies bounded, consistent declarations; provider implementation and physical time bounds still require separate evidence; synthetic data require explicit offline authorization

session_lease.scope: host acquire before CAPS/INFO through reader cleanup; target BEGIN through producer/consumer cleanup
session_lease.rule: atomically reject a new session while any entrant owns resources; all entrypoints and the sole reader must consult the same gate; no preemption or borrowing existing buffers
session_lease.recovery: internal safety recovery remains authoritative and revokes INSTALL; source/configuration/boot change invalidates the frozen binding
session_lease.cancel_linearization: stop producer publication first, retain consumer-owned slots until acknowledged, never reuse a slot or declare cleanup while reader/consumer ownership remains
session_lease.release: host local release and target cleanup confirmation are distinct; uncertain target outcome remains UNKNOWN, and local resource release failure must prevent a second owner
session_lease.registration: reference models and injected offline providers only; current MaintenanceOwner/target entrypoints have no integrated INSTALL session gate

cancellation_bound.scope: GSHC cancellation request through confirmed target cleanup and host-reader quiescence; target receipt-to-logical-cleanup and ACK delivery are explicit subspans, never substitutes for the whole goal
cancellation_bound.unknown_term: NOT PROVEN, never zero; finite loop counts, FIFO byte times and host runtime do not establish STM32 WCET
cancellation_bound.existing_host: active Request deadline up to 5 s; Cleanup deadline 1 s / at most 8 exchanges; neither establishes a 500 ms end-to-end bound
cancellation_bound.transport: normal FIFO preserves line order; no priority insertion into a sample line without complete-frame arbitration proof

streaming_resource_profile.caps_pair_capacity: logical per-FACE record budget checked against negotiated TRAIN+HOLDOUT and host record limits; never a declaration that the MCU buffers all pairs
streaming_resource_profile.integration_gate: no target integration if complete INFO/owner/time/stack/WCET implementation cannot be proved within the unchanged allocation and current safety contracts

face_response.host_success: terminal success plus all complete CRC-checked pairs, exact TRAIN/HOLDOUT order, disjoint source samples and matching immutable metadata; otherwise UNKNOWN/FAILED
face_response.cancel: stop new samples; PENDING cleanup_complete=0 until owner cleanup; host release is distinct from target cleanup confirmation

face_plan.counts_source: explicit current CAPS train_pairs and holdout_pairs; not hardware-qualified defaults
face_plan.window_id: rid as 8 uppercase hex followed by T or V
face_plan.pose_id: P followed by rid as 8 uppercase hex
face_plan.source_continuity: same binding, pose, attempt and face; forward source sequence/time across role boundary
face_plan.interaction: user places one face still once; target automatically captures TRAIN then HOLDOUT and completes; no second start command
face_plan.revalidation: after adaptation, freeze fitting data and use CHECK_ONLY single transactions for missing fresh holdout faces; these transactions add no TRAIN data and cannot refit the candidate
face_plan.nonoverlap: disjoint original source samples and pair IDs; boundaries recorded; adjacent samples are not asserted statistically independent

sample.absent: zero padding is canonical; no fabricated values count as valid
sample.clock: only declared common target boot clock used for pairing; target emits zero in reserved host-clock slot; GSHC independently stamps actual per-part PC receive time for diagnostics
sample.assembly: CRC and binding checked per part; bounded slots and timeout; no latest-value substitution

fit_and_validation.imu_intrinsic_fit: six-face TRAIN records only: acceleration diagonal bias/scale and static gyro bias; recompute AM candidates from original physical measurements with the new candidate intrinsic, never stack an old correction
fit_and_validation.after_validation_driven_adaptation: retire every previously observed HOLDOUT window as adaptation history, never TRAIN; any added TRAIN invalidates candidate and requires fresh validation captured after final new TRAIN
fit_and_validation.fresh_validation_gate: fresh HOLDOUT coverage of all six faces under software conservative policy; missing evidence remains NEED_FRESH_VALIDATION, not success
fit_and_validation.mag_to_gyro: only R_GA * R_AM with explicitly supplied R_GA provenance

safety.legacy_fallback: disable new flow on explicit unsupported or missing automatic-face capability; never substitute legacy control commands
safety.disconnect: UNKNOWN; no automatic business replay; release owner after bounded cleanup attempt, retain raw samples and unconfirmed outcome

ssic.installation_kinds_2_to_8: review-pending; isolated draft only; not advertised as target support

firmware.required_interface: single FACE transaction with automatic role transition, immutable source snapshot and bounded sample drain; see GSHC installation integration note
